PYTHON_VERSION.description: Version of Python demanded. Can be a specific numeric version number or an alias

PYTHON_VENV.description: Path to a Python virtualenv (will create if nonexistent)

PYTHON_CUSTOM_EXECUTABLE_PATH.description: Path to existing host python3.exe executable. If specified, skips downloading or bootstrapping a new Python runtime.

PYTHON_USE_SYSTEM.description: Reuse host or existing Python runtime located at PYTHON_CUSTOM_EXECUTABLE_PATH rather than installing bundled Python.

PYTHON_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install PYTHON. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

PIP_FIND_LINKS.description: Directory or URL containing pre-downloaded Python wheels for offline installation.

PIP_NO_INDEX.description: When set to 1 or true, pip completely disables querying remote PyPI indexes.

PIP_WHEEL_DIR.description: Directory location of pre-downloaded .whl packages for offline pip installs.
